status_evidence.what_it_shows: The order's own extension chain ended 6.1.2022 (16.12.2020 -> 16.6.2021 -> 6.1.2022). This is NOT the end of the guideline's life: the statute itself was then amended.

status_evidence.quote: או עד יום כ' באלול התשפ"ט (31 באוגוסט 2029), לפי המוקדם
status_evidence.what_it_shows: Amendment 3 (S.H. 2933, 18.11.2021) reset the s.321(d) sunset to 30.6.2023, Amendment 5 (6.6.2023) to 31.12.2024, Amendment 10 (from 1.1.2025) to 31.8.2029. Pre-Law guidelines therefore did not lapse by time; they end earlier only when 'provisions replacing them are set under this Law' or the Minister cancels/declares them not in force (s.321(o1)).

s.3A applies the EU provisions listed in Schedule 2A 'in Israel to food' (all food operators), the English text is binding, and s.3A(y) makes adopted provisions prevail over local food legislation on the matters they regulate.

transitional_provisions: (1) s.321(d) keeps pre-Law guidelines alive until replaced by provisions under the Law, cancelled by the Minister, or 31.8.2029, whichever first; for heavy metals the replacement occurred on 1.1.2023 (1881/2006) and 4.8.2024 (2023/915), and the Ministry now lists the guideline as not in force (page updated 19.02.2026). (2) Amendment 10 s.58(a): a producer or importer who is not a proper importer could, by online form, keep producing/importing to the law as it stood on 31.12.2022 until 31.12.2024; that window has closed. (3) Thirteenth Schedule Part B(9) with s.321A(b): during 1.1.2025-31.8.2029 the guideline (order item 32) does not apply to operators applying the adopted provisions; it is not listed as surviving for anyone else on a contaminants matter. (4) s.3A(d)(4) and 2025 notice s.3: food produced/imported before an annex update takes effect may be sold to end of shelf life under the pre-update text. (5) Residual exception: raw meat, raw milk, honey and fresh shell eggs are excluded from the adopted 2023/915 (and from item 2), so no adopted EU ML governs them; whether any 2016 value retains effect for those four raw foods is unresolved (no s.321(o1) Reshumot notice found; the Ministry label is unqualified). (6) No grace period keeps the 2016 values for any other product class.
